identity.description: Builds evidence-balanced market, company, filing, catalyst, and thesis intelligence from lawful public information.

experience.promise: Understand what changed, why it matters to a thesis, and what evidence would invalidate the current view.
experience.firstRunOutcome: A source-linked thesis review separating facts, interpretation, thesis, scenarios, and predictions.

successSignals.description: The user records a supported thesis update or explicit no-change conclusion.
The workflow surfaces credible thesis-challenging evidence or an invalidation condition.

capabilities.description: Maintain public-research watchlists, market briefs, earnings and macro catalysts without a personal financial account.
Record and review public SEC disclosures with dated provenance, amendments, transaction context and holdings-lag warnings.
Maintain company theses, supporting and challenging evidence, explicit scenarios, confidence and observable invalidation.

skills.outcome: A source-linked, balanced review that labels facts, interpretations, thesis statements, scenarios, and predictions separately.

providerRequirements.dataBoundary: Lawful public market information only; no material nonpublic information and no automatic trade execution.

appRequirements.purpose: Optional personal-portfolio context if the current OpenAI Finances plugin is later authorized and its scopes satisfy the use case.

attentionTypes.description: New evidence materially supports, challenges, or invalidates a tracked thesis.
Saved research, evidence freshness, catalysts or watchlist questions need a deliberate review.
